rules: The UI shows a real link only when status is 'verified' for that exact meal and service. Status 'demo' shows a clearly labelled demo dialog with no link.
Plain HTTPS links only, exactly as copied from the service. No invented deep links, URL schemes or tracking parameters.
No price, stock, delivery or promotion claims. The prototype does not take orders or payment.

levels.exact_product: Opens this meal's own product page
levels.store_search: Opens a search for this meal inside one store
levels.store_page: Opens a store page; the shopper looks for the meal there
